caption:
Tomato Chutney / Thakkali Thokku

Ingredients
Base: 
-Oil 
-1 tsp urad dal 
-3 dry red chilies – broken
-5 black pepper, whole
-3 cloves
-2 tomatoes, chopped
-3 tbsp water to grind
-salt, to taste 

Tadka: 
-½ tbsp oil
-1 dry red chili 
-curry leaves
-½ tsp mustard seeds
-pinch of hing

-in a pan, add in your oil, urad dal, red chilli, whole pepper  cloves and hing
-then add in your chopped tomatoes and a little water and cook till soft , salt to taste of course
-cool this and blend it into a smooth paste

time to make the tadka, 
-in a clean pan, add your oil mustard seeds red chilli curry leaves  and hing 
-add in your tomato paste allow to cook for a few minutes and enjoy
